title: FCS Profile
description: A deployment context profile. It narrows which controls apply. Technical stack may be DETECTED from the codebase; legal role and jurisdiction obligations must NOT be guessed and are declared explicitly.

kind.description: An obliged entity carries AML/licensing duties directly; a vendor supplies software to one and does NOT inherit those duties. 'unknown' when not declared.

declared.description: Must be true. Legal role is DECLARED, never inferred from the presence of users in a country.

jurisdictions.description: Jurisdictions whose obligations the entity has DECLARED it is subject to. Having users in a country does not by itself add that country's regulator obligations.

data_categories.description: Data categories the system holds. Retention, erasure and legal hold are modeled PER category, never as one blanket period.

payment_providers.description: Declared payment/provider integrations (e.g. 'stripe'). Provider-specific terms (void vs refund vs reversal) are resolved against that provider, not universalized.

detected.description: True when the stack was detected from the codebase rather than declared.

stack.description: Technical stack. MAY be detected from data/files; this is the one part inference is allowed for.

assumptions.description: Explicit context assumptions carried into control selection, so they are visible rather than silent.

overlays.description: Organization overlay profile ids layered on top. Conflicts are surfaced with reasons, never silently overridden; a stricter-looking sentence is NOT automatically treated as legally superior.
